steps.text: 7:25 A.M. \ Overcast
Ten kilometers from Londinium, wilderness highway

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Blacksteel's aircraft was about a hundred meters ahead of our position when its signal disappeared.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Let me grab the telescope to pinpoint the precise location–– Wait, why are you standing up?!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Do you smell the smoke?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Don't think so...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You can put that lump of metal down. The aircraft is right ahead.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: You want to scout out the enemy's numbers first?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Can't be any more than thirty.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Uhh, you can tell all that from smell alone?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: The hell are you talking about? Before we left, Morgan told me they usually run in squads of thirty.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Oh, right, that's what the intel Misery sent back said. Patterns tell us they should have two other squads nearby to offer mutual support.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Hmph. They act like they own the damned place.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Don't do anything rash. Amiya said not to make too much of a ruckus before we get into Londinium. Too many forces have their eyes on us.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Balin, how long has it been since you joined the bunny's squad and started working with us?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: About five days since leaving the landship.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: And do you know how long it took for Siege to go from joining the Glasgow Gang to becoming my boss?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Two days. She only needed two days.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: First day, she beat me down. Second day, we beat down a band of ill-intentioned Leithanians.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Since then, we've had a bond that goes beyond life and death.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Even though we haven't been working together very long, I have full confidence in your strength, Indra.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: That's what I like to hear. Let's go, we need to catch up to Dagda.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Dagda's already moved out?! Are you telling me dark shadow that shot past was...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: When she first joined the gang, she had her nose turned up like some fancy knight-noble. Now whenever there's a fight, she's the first one to leap in.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: We're gonna have to pick up the pace, or she'll clean house before we even get there.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Dagda throws a mean punch, and I can bet you she'll flip on top of the aircraft from the side. We'll wrap around the back, get rid of anyone there, and bust our way inside.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Alright, I'll cover you then.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: After this fight, you'll be a blood brother.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Ha... Haha...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: If I was to describe it in Rhodes Island's terms... Lemme think. Something like this...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Our objectives are two rescues: one Londinium citizen and one Blacksteel pilot. Opposing forces are––

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Dublinn.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier A
steps.text: You, stop squirming. Don't even try to reach for the transmitter.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: D-Don't kill me! My hand's gone numb and I just wanted to shake it out a little...

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier B
steps.text: Don't be too forceful. If you really end up killing the bloke, how are you gonna explain it to the captain when we get back?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier B
steps.text: Don't forget, this is our objective. Securing our flight back is just a matter of convenience.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier A
steps.text: Do you know how to operate it?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier B
steps.text: Not a clue.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier A
steps.text: And that's why you shouldn't have killed the damned pilot as soon as you got in here! If you ask me, we stop wasting time, take this one back, and leave this rubbish heap behind.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier B
steps.text: All the men along the road outside are ours. What difference does it make if we take some extra time? The Sarkaz are inside the city, and the Grand Duke's army is stationed in the barracks of the annexed plate. Nobody's gonna bother us.

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: G-Gentlemen, are you not Sarkaz?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier A
steps.text: Your eyes fall out of your head? Do we look anything like that filth to you?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: F-Filth, huh... Haha... You're exactly right...

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier B
steps.text: Enough. Don't talk to the Londiniers unless you're interrogating them. If this runt has the stones to cross the Sarkaz, there's no saying who we might be dealing with here.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier A
steps.text: You're right, we should be on the cautious side. Hurry it up, I'm gonna see what the commotion is out there.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier B
steps.text: What just happened?

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Sir, my heart's pounding too loud... I couldn't hear anything.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier B
steps.text: We're under attack?! There's something above us–– M-709, do you see them? M-709?!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier B
steps.text: Black... claws? Some sort of wild beast?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier B
steps.text: N-No! It's–– some kind of special weapon!!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier B
steps.text: All hands, an enemy is hiding atop the aircraft! They're... trying to rip apart the metal––

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier B
steps.text: Ugh–-!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: You managed to block me.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: The intel was right, you aren't just a band of highwaymen. You grew fat off Victoria's teat, and this is how you repay her, soldier?

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier B
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... You're pretty strong. You working for the devils?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Bastard!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: How dare you... I'm pissed enough to beat the tar out of you ten times over.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Remember this, Dublinn soldier. We will reclaim Londinium from her usurpers. Be it from the Sarkaz, or from you traitors––

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Your time running around like you own this place is over.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier B
steps.text: Heh... Hah... Look at you, all high and mighty. You nobles... still trying to cling to the old times.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier B
steps.text: Looks like you're after this little coward who ran away from the Sarkaz, and the information he has on him––

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: They're switching targets?!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: H-Help! Save me!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Leave him alone!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: This is... a decoy?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: You little shit!

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier B
steps.text: Urgh!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: How many times have I told you? When you're in a fight, always be on the lookout for tricks.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: You're late.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: That's because I helped you clean up a band of hooligans outside, no? Hey, tell her, how many did we have to go through outside? Seven, or was it eight?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: This isn't a competition.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: That's not what your face is saying.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Back when we went on our first mission together, that one merc got away from you. You were livid for three days. Morgan thought you’d come down with some awful sickness.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: You had the same look on your face just now.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: What happened back then was my fault. Plus, it was a long, long time ago.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier B
steps.text: *cough* *cough*... Where... did you people come from? The one in black... I thought she was some knight-noble. But the way you hit is like...

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Like a street thug? Hah, you know your stuff.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Hurry up. That one's no weakling. It'll be tougher to take him down than the unconscious louts out outside.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: They're able to freely move between the Sarkaz and the Duke's forces, and even able to control major passages in and out of Londinium. Dublinn isn't some ragtag group of mercs.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: We need to rescue the hostages as quickly as possible and get to somewhere safe.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: I know. 'Your time running around like you own the place is over,' right?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: That’s a lousy one-liner, not nearly scary enough.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Remember what I taught you? What you say is––

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: This is your last chance to beg for mercy.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier B
steps.text: Ugh... M-701, requesting backup... Captain Mandragora...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Dagda, Indra, we’ve got incoming! I'd suggest we bail!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Grr... They sure move fast.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: You were in charge of recon, you didn't spot anyone nearby?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Too much work. We'll just take 'em out as they come.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Balin... please stay hidden. Indra and I will take care of the incoming hostiles.

steps.name: Dublinn Soldier
steps.text: They're inside!

steps.name: Londinium Citizen
steps.text: Ladies, p-please save me! I don't want to fall into their hands again!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Gah, shut your trap and do a better job of hiding.

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Dagda, we're good as long as we bring back the objectives, right? Shouldn't be an issue if we take apart this blasted lump of metal, yeah?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: This is one story you're gonna have to tell Siege when we get back.
